facts.fact: Erin Morrison 在世上的最后一个八月是难熬的：潮湿、无尽、三十一天的黏腻重复。
facts.anchor: Erin Morrison’s final August on the planet was a slog. Humid and endless, thirty-one days of sticky repetition.

facts.fact: 那个八月每晚 David 都用 CVS 员工折扣买来家庭装 rainbow sherbet，下班直奔 Erin 的地下室；两人坐在同一个豆袋椅上共用一把勺子。
facts.anchor: Every night that August, David brought over a family-size tub of rainbow sherbet that he bought with his CVS employee discount. He drove straight to Erin’s basement after work, and together the two of them would sit on a single beanbag sharing a spoon

facts.fact: 广播通常发生在凌晨两点左右：David 察觉到第一丝干扰后把 Erin 摇醒，两人一起看那个标志性标志从静态中探出。
facts.anchor: It usually happened around the two a.m. hour, just as Erin was starting to drift off on her side of the beanbag. David would notice the first hint of interference, then he’d shake his friend awake just in time for them both to watch that iconic logo peek through the static.

facts.fact: 那个八月 Toshiba 上最常出现的访客是 Erin 自己的二重身，每晚必然重复同样的话，像睡前祷词；而 Erin 对录制这些传送毫无记忆（账板统计里 Static Erin Doppelganger 以十五次居首）。
facts.anchor: But that August, by far the most frequent visitor to Erin’s Toshiba was Erin herself. The doppelganger version who stared back from behind glass, who without fail would repeat those same words every night, like a bedtime prayer.

facts.fact: 开学后账板统计各「演员」出场次数：Creepy Moaning Old Woman 五次、Spatula Handed Housewife 三次、Pigtail Fruit Shirt 八次，Static Erin Doppelganger 以十五次居首（记号由 Ralph 的弟弟 Gerald、incoming freshman、Auxiliaries 新兵负责添加）。
facts.anchor: “Creepy Moaning Old Woman” had five tallies next to her column, meaning five appearances total. “Spatula Handed Housewife” had three. “Pigtail Fruit Shirt,” eight. “Static Erin Doppelganger” was in the lead with a whopping fifteen tally marks to date.

facts.fact: Leslie 六月毕业，现在几小时外、在 Boston 开始上大学；所谓「twins」因一岁之差在夏天不情愿地分手，也许永远分离。
facts.anchor: Leslie had graduated back in June, and she was now hours away, starting college in Boston. The so-called “twins” had reluctantly broken up over the summer, separated, perhaps forever, by their one-year age gap.

facts.fact: 开学第一天 Erin 在电梯里对 David 说：整个夏天她都在等可怕的事发生在自己身上，不想整个学年也这样等下去（她提出想暂时从 Public Access Afterworld 抽身）。
facts.anchor: I spent the entire summer waiting for something terrible to happen to me, and I don’t really want to spend all school year waiting for the same thing.

facts.fact: 周五深夜车里（时钟跳到 11:56 p.m.），David 掏出那盘 VHS——正是 Jim Davis 小屋那晚标签 ERIN MORRISON 2/5/83 的同一盘——并说里面是老情景喜剧 Short Stack，那晚 Jim Davis 想给 Erin 看的就是它。
facts.anchor: “That’s what’s on it,” David said. “Short Stack. The old sitcom. That’s what Jim Davis wanted to show you that night.”
